claims.title: Dots different internally checked ungauged boundary;quantum gauging open

Extra local resources are finite but not evaluated and may be enormous. No civilisation-level capability is claimed. No ZIP, governing proof package, explicit model/particle set, resource sizes, error bounds or formal uniform-limit quantifiers were supplied with the message. Finite but unquantified local resources do not establish practicality or a parameter-uniform finite implementation.
